## otakumode.com (Information)

- https://otakumode.com/otapedia/games/final_fantasy/final_fantasy_15 -- story, dates, platforms -- accessed 2026-10-17 (fetched by me, text pasted by user; Tokyo Otaku Mode's Otapedia, sections Final Fantasy XV Plot, Gameplay, Characters, Development)
  - Final Fantasy XV Plot: a short recap (Eos, the Niflheim empire, the Crystal of Lucis stolen during peace talks, Noctis's mission as the "True King", the antagonist Ardyn); agrees with the entry's description (Niflheim invades and steals the Crystal, Noctis goes on a quest); it calls the capital "Lucis" where the entry says Insomnia (the Lucian capital), a slip on the page, nothing to report
  - Release: PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in 2016, Windows in 2018, Stadia in 2019; originally Final Fantasy Versus XIII; consistent with the entry (2016-11-29)
  - Its Development section covers the Versus XIII history, Tabata taking over from Nomura and the Universe tie-ins (Kingsglaive, Brotherhood); developer content, outside our scope, and the tie-ins are entries
- https://otakumode.com/otapedia/games/final_fantasy/ffxv_pocket_edition -- Pocket Edition story, dates, platforms -- accessed 2026-10-17 (fetched by me, text pasted by user; Tokyo Otaku Mode's Otapedia, sections Plot, Gameplay, Characters, Development; the Pocket Edition version of this entry)
  - Plot: the same recap as its main-game page (Eos, Niflheim stealing the Crystal, Noctis the "True King", the antagonist Ardyn), for an abridged version with ten chapters; agrees with the Pocket Edition version of the entry; it again calls the capital "Lucis" where the game says Insomnia
  - Release: an abridged Final Fantasy XV on PlayStation 4, iOS, Android, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch in 2018; the first of its ten chapters is free and the rest are bought individually or as a whole; consistent with the entry's Pocket Edition version (2018) and its platform rows (Windows came later); its Gameplay section covers the tap-to-move controls, fixed camera and cut side quests, game-mechanics content outside our scope
  - Its Development section links a Kotaku review (https://kotaku.com/final-fantasy-xv-pocket-edition-keeps-things-nice-and-s-1822819713): a review, outside our scope; not read by me
